description:
## Why

DKIM public keys, SPF policies, and DMARC policies live in DNS and
are routinely rotated or removed. Once gone, signed emails cannot be
re-verified and the authentication posture at delivery time is
unrecoverable. stoa sees all of this at ingest time and can cache it
before it disappears.

## What

At article/message ingest, for each arriving item:

**DKIM** — for each DKIM-Signature header, extract d= and s=, fetch
{s}._domainkey.{d} TXT, store raw TXT as CID blob + parsed fields.

**SPF** — extract envelope From domain (or From: header domain), fetch
{domain} TXT records matching v=spf1, store raw TXT as CID blob.

**DMARC** — extract From: header domain, fetch _dmarc.{domain} TXT,
store raw TXT as CID blob + parsed p= policy field.

**ARC** — extract ARC-Message-Signature headers, same DKIM-style
selector lookup for each hop's signing key. (Same code path as DKIM.)

## Unified table design

All evidence types share one table with an evidence_type discriminator:

```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dns_auth_cache (
    evidence_type TEXT    NOT NULL,  -- 'dkim' | 'spf' | 'dmarc' | 'arc'
    domain        TEXT    NOT NULL,
    selector      TEXT    NOT NULL,  -- DKIM/ARC selector; '' for SPF/DMARC
    record_cid    TEXT    NOT NULL,  -- CID of raw TXT blob; '' for tombstone
    first_seen_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
    last_seen_ms  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ttl_secs      INTEGER,
    algorithm     TEXT,              -- 'rsa'|'ed25519'; NULL for SPF/DMARC
    key_bytes     BLOB,              -- public key bytes; NULL for SPF/DMARC
    policy        TEXT,              -- raw policy string for SPF/DMARC; NULL for DKIM
    record_status TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',  -- 'active'|'rotated'|'revoked'
    PRIMARY KEY (evidence_type, domain, selector, record_cid)
);
```

## Design decisions (already agreed)

- Raw TXT as CID blob + parsed fields in SQL
- DNS TTL stored at fetch time
- Compound PK preserves full rotation history
- Tombstone rows when DNS returns NODATA for a known record
- DnsAuthCache struct called from pipeline.rs via Option<&DnsAuthCache> in PipelineCtx
- No background re-poll; ingest-driven only
title: DNS authentication evidence cache: DKIM keys, SPF, DMARC records
